dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, do you have a cat?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈkæt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, I don't. But I have a puppy!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈdoʊnt. bət aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈpʌpi!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Its name is Maple. It's very cute!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈneɪm ɪz ˈmeɪpəl. ɪts ˈvɛri ˈkjuːt!
